you don’t need to know everything about ai to start creating good ai videos.

you just need the right workflow.

1. pinterest

pinterest is a great place to find visual inspiration.

look for scenes, characters, camera angles, lighting, transitions, fashion, environments and video styles that match what you want to create.

you can also get inspiration from tiktok, instagram, x, youtube and even movies.

the goal isn’t to copy everything you see.

find the parts you like, combine them with your own idea, and build something original.

2. chatgpt

this is where your idea becomes a proper prompt.

take your reference image or explain the scene you want to recreate to chatgpt.

ask it to describe the important details in the scene, including the environment, character position, camera angle, lighting, movement and overall mood.

then ask chatgpt to turn that description into a detailed prompt for your ai video.

if you have a reference character, clearly tell chatgpt to preserve the character’s identity, face, hairstyle, body structure, clothing and other important features without unnecessary changes.

you can also use voice notes to explain your idea instead of typing everything.

3. storyboard

before generating the entire video, break it into smaller scenes.

for example:

scene 1 → 3 seconds
scene 2 → 4 seconds
scene 3 → 5 seconds
scene 4 → 4 seconds

a storyboard is simply a visual plan for your video.

it shows what should happen in each scene before you start generating and animating everything.

you can create the storyboard yourself or use chatgpt to help you build the prompts for each frame.

try to keep the same character, visual style and resolution throughout the storyboard so the final video feels consistent.

4. choose your ai video tool

once your prompts and storyboard are ready, you can move into the generation stage.

some tools you can experiment with include:

• google flow
• gemini / veo
• grok
• higgsfield
• seedance 2.5
• trimz
• capcut

different tools will give you different results, so experiment and see which one works best for your style.

5. choose your resolution

this part matters more than beginners usually think.

for a vertical social media video, you can use 9:16.

for youtube or a wider cinematic video, 16:9 is usually a better choice.

for square content, you can use 1:1.

you can also work with common resolutions such as:

• 1080 × 1920 for vertical video
• 1920 × 1080 for landscape video
• 1080 × 1080 for square video

choose your resolution based on where the video will be posted.

6. generate and edit

now take your prompt and storyboard into your chosen ai video tool and generate your scenes.

once you have the clips, you can bring them into capcut for further editing.

capcut can also be used for ai video creation, so you can experiment with generating, editing, adding text, sound effects, music, transitions and adjusting the final aspect ratio all in one place.

the complete process is simple:

inspiration → chatgpt → storyboard → ai generation → editing

the better your reference, prompt and storyboard, the more control you have over the final video.

you’re not just asking ai to make a video, you’re giving it a clear visual direction to follow.

Why I believe it’s still early in Coinsilium’s next chapter. 🟠🟡

Coinsilium has built exposure across several developing areas of crypto and AI. Each offers something different:

🟡 Yellow Network — $YELLOW
Infrastructure for clearing and settling transactions across blockchains. Coinsilium has an allocation of 50 million tokens, subject to vesting. Yellow entered live operation in March 2026.

🤖 Otomato
DeFi portfolio monitoring, intelligence and automation, helping users understand positions across different protocols. Coinsilium holds approximately 1.25% of developer Dyment Labs, plus a token warrant.

🔎 Predictive Labs / Nijinn
Brings prediction-market data together into an intelligence platform for professionals, developers and AI agents. Coinsilium’s reported investment reached US$450,000, representing approximately 14.91%.

🎨 BeatingHeart
Developing generative AI tools for advertising images and video, initially targeting fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands. Coinsilium agreed a convertible loan facility of up to US$250,000 alongside strategic advisory support.

₿ Forza — Bitcoin exposure through $BTC
Coinsilium’s wholly owned subsidiary manages its strategic Bitcoin treasury.

For me, “early days” means these ventures still have opportunities to develop products, attract users and build commercial revenues. Their success—and the value ultimately reaching Coinsilium shareholders—depends on execution.

That’s the longer-term story I’m watching.
